newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme in drug search with LeukoSite Inc.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme in drug search with LeukoSite Inc.

text.p: Genzyme General Corp said Wednesday it has agreed to collaborate with Leukosite Inc to identify new drug candidates for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Genzyme said privately owned LeukoSite will screen the Genzyme library for compounds related to cell adhesion and inflammatory bowel disease.
The two companies will then negotiate a research agreement for the development and commercialization of active compounds discovered during the screening.
